turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We're trying to work out the entertainment for my nephew's fifth birthday.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll tell you all the choices first. Wait until I'm finished before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A magician who does a forty minute show and makes balloon animals at the end.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Renting a little petting zoo with rabbits, a goat and some chickens in the garden.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A face painter who stays the whole afternoon so kids can drop in whenever they want.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or no entertainer at all, just old school games like sack races and pass the parcel that we run ourselves.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Five year olds sit still for a magician only if the show is short and loud, and forty minutes is pushing it. The petting zoo is unforgettable but needs space and a forgiving garden. A face painter plus a couple of your own games is a really solid middle ground.
